memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: 27‑year‑old male shop owner reports recurrent sneezing, nasal congestion, itchy eyes and daily hives for 8 months.
EXAMINATION: BP 118/76 mmHg, weight 68 kg, height 1.70 m, BMI 23.5 (overweight). Nasal mucosa pale, turbinates mildly swollen. Skin shows scattered wheals on arms and trunk.
IMPRESSION: Allergic rhinitis and chronic urticaria.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start cetirizine 10 mg HS, fluticasone nasal spray 1 spray each nostril OD, montelukast 10 mg HS, levocetirizine 5 mg OD. Advise weight control, daily aerobic activity. Return if wheezing, facial swelling, fever >39°C, or severe dyspnea.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Cetirizine 10 mg tablet – take 1 tablet at night.
Fluticasone nasal spray 50 mcg – 1 spray each nostril once daily.
Montelukast 10 mg tablet – take 1 tablet at night.
Levocetirizine 5 mg tablet – take 1 tablet each morning.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Total Serum IgE: 420 IU/mL (Reference: <100 IU/mL) – Elevated.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Skin prick test – positive reaction to house dust mite (3+ wheal) and grass pollen (2+ wheal). Negative to common foods.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: ‘I’ve been taking the medicines as prescribed. The nasal congestion is better but I still get hives most evenings, especially after eating out.’

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Return visit – reports improved nasal symptoms but persistent nocturnal hives and occasional facial swelling after meals.
EXAMINATION: BP 120/78 mmHg, weight 67.5 kg, BMI 23.3 (overweight). No nasal polyps. Skin: occasional wheals on trunk, no angioedema.
IMPRESSION: Allergic rhinitis well controlled; chronic urticaria partially responsive.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue cetirizine HS and fluticasone OD. Stop montelukast (no added benefit). Increase levocetirizine to 10 mg HS. Add short course of prednisolone 10 mg OD for 5 days if hives worsen. Advise food diary, avoid known triggers. Return if swelling of lips/tongue, difficulty breathing, or fever.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Cetirizine 10 mg tablet – take 1 tablet at night.
Fluticasone nasal spray 50 mcg – 1 spray each nostril once daily.
Levocetirizine 10 mg tablet – take 1 tablet at night.
Prednisolone 5 mg tablet – take 2 tablets daily after food for 5 days (as needed).

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Complete Blood Count: WBC 6.2 x10^9/L, Hemoglobin 13.8 g/dL, Platelets 240 x10^9/L, Eosinophils 0.5 x10^9/L (5%). Reference eosinophils <0.4 x10^9/L – Mild eosinophilia.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Follow‑up – reports hives reduced to 2‑3 times weekly, nasal symptoms minimal.
EXAMINATION: BP 119/77 mmHg, weight 66.8 kg, BMI 23.1 (overweight). No nasal congestion. Skin: few scattered wheals, no angioedema.
IMPRESSION: Both allergic rhinitis and chronic urticaria improving on current regimen.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue cetirizine HS, fluticasone OD, levocetirizine HS. Tapering prednisolone stopped. Review weight and activity. Return if worsening hives, facial swelling, or respiratory symptoms.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Cetirizine 10 mg tablet – take 1 tablet at night.
Fluticasone nasal spray 50 mcg – 1 spray each nostril once daily.
Levocetirizine 10 mg tablet – take 1 tablet at night.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Total Serum IgE: 310 IU/mL (Reference: <100 IU/mL) – Still elevated but down from 420.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Annual review – patient reports occasional mild nasal itch during pollen season, hives rare (<1/month).
EXAMINATION: BP 122/80 mmHg, weight 66.2 kg, BMI 22.9 (normal range). No nasal mucosal swelling. Skin clear.
IMPRESSION: Allergic rhinitis and chronic urticaria well controlled; BMI now normal.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue cetirizine HS and fluticasone OD. Consider stopping levocetirizine if symptom‑free for another 3 months. Offer influenza vaccine (patient declined). Return if new wheezing, angioedema, fever >39°C, or unexplained weight loss.
